screenSummary.playArea: The telescope view shows the foreground galaxy and the distorted images of a fixed background galaxy.
screenSummary.controlArea: Change the alignment, adjust the Einstein radius, or show the alignment guides.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Try the Ring preset, then nudge the foreground galaxy to see how the image changes.

galaxy.lensHelp: Use the arrow keys to move the galaxy. Hold Shift for smaller steps.
galaxy.details: {{pattern}}. Foreground galaxy relative to the background galaxy: x {{x}}, y {{y}} arcseconds. Separation {{offset}} arcseconds. Einstein radius {{radius}} arcseconds.

screenSummary.playArea: The light curve plots the combined brightness of the unresolved star images. A sky diagram shows the relative positions of the stars.
screenSummary.controlArea: Play or scrub the event. Change the closest separation or the time to move one Einstein radius.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Decrease the minimum separation and compare peak brightness.

microlensing.details: Day {{day}} relative to closest approach. Current brightness {{current}} times unlensed brightness. Peak brightness {{peak}} times unlensed brightness. Minimum separation {{impact}} Einstein radii. Einstein crossing time {{duration}} days.

galaxy.subtitle: Move the foreground galaxy and watch one background galaxy change shape.
galaxy.oneState: One image of the source center
galaxy.twoState: Two images of the source center
galaxy.hint: Align the two galaxy centers to form a ring. A small offset stretches the light into arcs.

microlensing.subtitle: Follow a background star as it passes behind a foreground star that acts as a lens.
microlensing.hint: The two stellar images appear as one point. Their combined light makes the star appear brighter.
